## SCOPE NOTE
This harness verifies the /merge command's bash logic in ISOLATION against
synthetic post-/dev-overnight worktree states. It does NOT verify the
integrated /dev-overnight + /merge end-to-end cycle on a real project.

Result interpretation:
- All 7 ACs PASS → /merge half of AC12 is empirically verified
- Saga AC12 still requires a future fresh session to run a real /dev-overnight
  cycle that ends with /merge invocation; this harness predicts that future
  cycle will succeed but does not substitute for it

qa_advisory_objections_addressed.summary: Variable scoping across extracted bash blocks: no `local` decoration, preserve subshell scope

qa_advisory_objections_addressed.summary: Scenario A setup MUST run `git remote set-head origin -a` so origin/HEAD exists
qa_advisory_objections_addressed.addressed_in: setup-A.sh runs `git remote set-head origin -a` after the initial push; setup-B.sh and setup-C.sh do the same. Without this, AC-AC12-1 false-fails because the resolver falls through to the master fallback.

qa_advisory_objections_addressed.summary: Scenario A 'dirty' worktree must produce non-empty git add -A diff
qa_advisory_objections_addressed.addressed_in: setup-A.sh creates new-file.txt AND appends a line to existing-file.txt inside the worktree. Pre-state assertion confirms dirty_lines>=1; without this, Step 4 would take the clean-tree exit-0 branch and skip the auto-bulk path.

qa_advisory_objections_addressed.summary: Scenario C colliding file must be committed ON the worktree branch
qa_advisory_objections_addressed.addressed_in: setup-C.sh commits new-feature.tsx on the worktree branch (worktree-overnight-C) so the diff main...worktree-overnight-C lists it; the parent-side same-path file is created untracked. Pre-state assertion confirms both: TOUCHED set contains new-feature.tsx AND UNTRACKED set contains new-feature.tsx.
